Use case: identity-preserve. Production 2D character animation sprites, not a collage illustration.
Reference is the EXISTING cream kitten animation atlas. Use its first row as the action/anatomy reference and preserve the exact same kitten identity, cream plush fur, amber eyes, green leaf-print triangular scarf, proportions, camera and soft lighting.
Create ONE continuous WAVE action containing EXACTLY 24 chronologically ordered frames, read LEFT TO RIGHT then TOP TO BOTTOM. The entire output is a 6 COLUMN x 4 ROW grid of 24 equal square cells on a landscape 3:2 canvas. All four rows continue the SAME SINGLE ACTION; each row is NOT a separate repeat! Each cell must show one complete solid kitten, genuinely transparent background, no floor/shadow/grid/labels/text. Keep the same head size, center x and grounded foot baseline in ALL frames. Leave 12% padding, ears/paws/tail never touch cell edges. Render crisp detailed fur, no motion blur, no double exposure, no half-transparent limbs, no extra paws. Keep head/facial design consistent while limbs move smoothly, with very small changes from one cell to the next.
Motion choreography, mandatory: ONE gentle paw-wave action with TWO small side-to-side waves. Always the SAME viewer-left front paw. Frames 1-2 original sitting rest; 3-7 gradually bend elbow and raise paw from chest to cheek in five distinctly spaced intermediate positions; 8-10 paw arcs outward beside face; 11-13 paw arcs inward; 14-16 a smaller outward arc; 17-19 paw lowers smoothly through three intermediate heights; 20-23 elbow folds and paw settles into resting position; 24 matches frame 1. Keep the head mostly stable, eyes open except one brief happy squint at peak. Do not repeat the same paw height through an entire row.
Critical: this request adds the missing intermediate body poses. Every middle frame advances the limb/body position a SMALL amount. Do not supply six keyframes repeated four times. Do not fill rows with duplicates or only change facial expressions. First and final resting poses must match the original reference sitting size and shape.
